name: Alistair McGregor
bio:
Alistair's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching rally races in the Scottish Highlands. This early exposure fuelled his determination to contribute to the sport he loved. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, he quickly established himself as a promising talent, initially working as a data analyst for a small racing team before transitioning to a management role.

His meticulous approach to problem-solving, combined with his innate understanding of vehicle dynamics, allows him to effectively bridge the gap between the technical and strategic aspects of racing. Alistair thrives on the pressure of race weekends, expertly coordinating team efforts and making split-second decisions that can make or break a race. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to inspire confidence within the team, ensuring everyone is working towards a common goal.

What sets Alistair apart is his relentless pursuit of improvement. He's constantly analyzing performance data, seeking out innovative solutions, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. He believes in empowering his team members, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and motivated to excel.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly trimmed, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a lean build and a focused look.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee before every race.
